properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 964749

Nearest City: Yorktown, VA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: LISTED HAZ WASTE F037/F038
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: WESTERN REFINING YORKTOWN, INC.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 500 gallons
AN 18” DIAMETER SEWER BYPASS LINE RUPTURED WHILE FLUSHING WITH FIRE WATER, RESULTING IN A RELEASE OF F037/F038 SLUDGE AND CONTACT WATER. AN ESTIMATED 5 TO 10 POUNDS OF SOLIDS AND 500 GALLONS OF IMPACT WATER SPILLED ONTO THE ROADWAY AND ADJACENT EMBANKMENTS AND INTO THE STORM WATER DITCH. THE WATER WAS SHUT OFF AND SOLIDS CLEANED FROM THE ROAD. OIL DRY WAS DEPLOYED ON THE ROADWAY AND OIL ABSORBENT BLANKETS AND HAY BALES WERE PLACED IN THE DITCH TO CONTAIN THE VISIBLE OIL SHEEN. THE DITCH WAS THEN DEWATERED INTO A VACUUM TRUCK. THE RELEASE WAS FULLY CONTAINED ON SITE AND NO RELEASE TO NAVIGABLE WATERS OCCURRED. THE REMAINING STAINED SOILS WILL BE EXCAVATED AND PROPERLY DISPOSED.

Report Description/// UPDATE TO INCIDENT REPORT # 1417696 /// UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WAS A RELEASE OF ANHYDROUS AMMONIA INTO THE ATMOSPHERE FROM A CYLINOID VALVE ON THE COMPRESSOR IN THE FACILITY. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE WAS DUE TO THE CYLINOID VALVE FAILING AND BLOWING OFF THE COMPRESSOR. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE AMMONIA IGNITED DUE TO UNKNOWN REASONS AT THIS TIME, WHICH CAUSED AN EXPLOSION. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE FACILITY WAS EVACUATED OF ALL PERSONNEL, BUT THE NUMBER IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME. THE HAMILTON TOWNSHIP FIRE DEPARTMENT ARRIVED ON SCENE TO SECURE THE RELEASE AND VENT THE BUILDING. THE FIRE BURNT OUT ON ITS OWN. THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WERE NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES IN THE INCIDENT, THE CALLER ALSO STATES THAT AFTER HAMILTON FIRE DEPARTMENT AND AN UNKNOWN HAZMAT TEAM ARRIVED ON SCENE A 1.5 MILE EVACUATION RADIUS WAS IN PLACE. THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WAS ABOUT 5 HOUSES IN THE AREA OF THE 1.5 EVACUATION RADIUS THAT WERE EVACUATED, BUT THE NUMBER OF PERSONNEL EVACUATED FROM THE HOUSES IS UNKNOWN. ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER REPORTED A RELEASE OF AMMONIA DUE TO UNKNOWN REASONS.
